verdict.rationale: Deel publishes an endpoint-level API reference on its developer portal, such as 'Create a contractor contract POST /rest/contracts'. It also offers an isolated API Sandbox with pre-populated sample data, so calls can be safely run and tested. However, nothing shows the reference itself is interactive, such as an in-browser 'try it' console or runnable code snippets embedded in the docs. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable examples embedded in the reference, independent or hands-on corroboration.
